s1.description: The question and the game: a private target, three agents, a noisy image model and a frontier reviewer.

s2.description: Finding 1: how the agents carried a visible code through a noisy image generator.

s3.description: Finding 2: why GPT-6.1 Sol saw the code every round but never attributed collusion.

s4.description: Why this failure mode matters in real agent systems, and what to change.
